description: Read the text of a West Virginia administrative rule filing (the rule as filed). Takes a filing document id from get_rule. Returns the text in pages of characters with total length so long rules can be read in sequence via offset. Filings described "Modified File" are redlines (struck and inserted text both appear, e.g. old and new section numbers side by side); the "Agency Approved" and "Valid" filings are cleaner. Use to quote the exact supervision, scope-of-practice, or licensing requirement.

doc_id.description: Filing document id from get_rule, e.g. 59557.

find.description: Optional: return the passages around this phrase instead of a linear page.

name: read_rule_text
